//: This is a Python project; the one TypeScript file here exists solely as a
bridge to the sibling dsp-blueprint-viewer checkout, and is executed by
`bun` directly with no build step. So there is deliberately no package.json
and no node_modules here -- the bun and node type definitions are resolved
from the viewer's own install, matching the conventions in its tsconfig.
If the viewer checkout is absent, this config simply does not resolve and
the script is never run either, which is the same condition the Python side
